SfdcCustomerForPartner.name: SfdcCustomerForPartner
SfdcCustomerForPartner.description: Represents a customer associated with a Salesforce partner. Records appear in the Partner Business Org (PBO) and represent a partner's customer for the purpose of storing billing information.

AccountId.description: References a specific account from the Account object in the PBO.

BillingAddress.description: The default billing address for the customer, used to seed the billing address into new offers. Compound field.

BillingCustomerOrg.description: Required. 18 chararacter org ID that represents the billing org for a partner's customer. Must be a Paid Org.

BillingEmail.description: The default email address of the customer who receives billing details, used to seed new offers. This is typically someone in the accounting department.

BillingGeocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of geocoded billing address.

BillingLatitude.description: The latitude geo-coordinate for customer billing address.

BillingLongitude.description: The longitude geo-coordinate for customer billing address .

BillingPostalCode.description: The postal/zip code of the customer billing address.

BillingState.description: The state of the customer billing address.

BillingStreet.description: The street of the customer billing address.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

Name.description: Required. The name of the customer.

ShippingAddress.description: The default shipping address of the partner's customer. Compound field.

ShippingCity.description: The city of the customer shipping address.

ShippingCountry.description: The country of the customer shipping address.

ShippingGeocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of geocoded shipping address.

ShippingLatitude.description: The latitude geo-coordinate for customer shipping address.

ShippingLongitude.description: The longitude geo-coordinate for customer shipping address.

ShippingPostalCode.description: The postal/zip code of the shipping address.

ShippingState.description: The state of the customer shipping address.

ShippingStreet.description: The street of the customer shipping address.
